'''Gulli-ball stadiums''' were home to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan's]] most popular sport, [[Gulliball/Legends|gulliball]]. Hundreds if not thousands of Gungans would watch eagerly from the stands of the stadium to see their favorite teams whip around the [[Gullipud]] with poles. Gulli-ball stadiums probably also functioned as [[Nuna-ball/Legends|Nuna-ball]] stadiums. The stadium was lit with many light orbs that attached to the bubble supports of the building. A bubble was suspended over the field that displayed the teams' scores and time remaining. To signal half-time [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwings]] would be released.
